evidence: task.toml:20-24 reads `[environment]` / `build_timeout_sec = 600.0` / `network_mode = "public"` / `cpus = 2` / `memory_mb = 4096`. These are identical to the frozen template task.toml and to the task.toml block in references/staged-task-contract.md (`cpus = 2`, `memory_mb = 4096`); a diff of the task's task.toml against the template shows only name, description, keywords and metadata text changed. `[environment].docker_image` is absent and `allow_internet` is not present anywhere in task.toml, as check 9 in quality-checks.md requires. No env table or literal exists under `[environment]`. The only credential-shaped values in task.toml are in the frozen `[verifier.env]` block (task.toml:34 `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}"`, :35 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""`), a ${VAR} template and an empty string, which the skill lists as intentional and which belong to row 10 rather than the agent image. environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template Dockerfile (diff empty): `FROM node:22-bookworm-slim`, a single `ENV NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules`, no ARG, no token, no private registry login; git identity is the placeholder `turing@local.invalid`. A pattern scan of task.toml, instruction.md and everything under environment/ (Dockerfile, six instruction notes, 149-byte seed_data.json) for provider key shapes (sk-, sk-or-, AKIA, ghp_, xox), PEM blocks and the words api key / secret / password / token / bearer returned only the two verifier lines above and the word `tokens` in ui.md:13 (syntax colouring). Sanity of 2 CPU / 4096 MB for this workload: the agent image is a slim Node image with express and better-sqlite3 preinstalled globally; the reference install (solution/solve.sh) only copies a prebuilt app and performs no compile; an agent that chooses to npm install and run a Vite/TypeScript build fits comfortably in 4 GB, and the Dockerfile has no bare `nproc` or `--platform` pin. Measurement limits: the scripted golden run on these bytes ran in the agent image but the index does not record that the 2 CPU / 4096 MB limits were enforced; the hosted Oracle run that completed under these same [environment] values was on an earlier candidate (ZIP eda58464), so it is supporting evidence for the unchanged block only, not a measurement of these bytes. This row is a static configuration check and nothing in it depends on the missing configured-judge run.
